ctx.x: I can't even remember who the pallbearers were for Tony now other than you and I. I asked Don Lockie to come. I thought it'd be nice.
You and I and the boy from England. What does he play? Not Barry.
Played clarinet. Plays clarinet. Oh, I know who you're talking about. The fellow from Nottingham. That plays, he's from the same town as Andrew Hall. That's right. Wasn't Andrew Hall?
